violated_contract: A process-local admission sampler must not refuse a healthy shared service indefinitely by retrying a failed HTTP client forever while suppressing all per-replica errors.
canonical_prevention: Bound last-good observation age without renewing timestamps on failure, retain conservative quorum and unknown-replica accounting, recreate the HTTP client and rediscover after a bounded number of sweeps without a new quorum, and alarm on per-pod zero freshness or frozen sampler progress independently of admission traffic.
